purpose: Conceptual README artwork; not application screenshots, catalog product media or acceptance evidence.

assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: wide GitHub repository cover for DALE, a conversational shopping agent. Create an exceptionally refined editorial still life, landscape 2:1 composition. Off-white warm paper background #f5f5f0, deep black typography, brushed aluminum, graphite and clear glass. LEFT HALF: generous clean negative space with exact restrained serif wordmark text "DALE" in large elegant capitals; beneath it small clean sans-serif text exactly "Conversation. Catalog. Control." RIGHT HALF: sculptural, beautifully lit composition of an unbranded black smartphone, a clear rectangular fragrance bottle, silver over-ear headphones, and a fine steel wristwatch on low off-white architectural plinths. Realistic premium industrial photography, precise contact shadows, soft side lighting, quiet luxury, museum catalog art direction. Thin black horizontal rule near the bottom. No neon, no colorful gradients, no extra words, no logos on products, no UI screenshots, no invented performance claims, no badges. This is conceptual brand artwork, not product evidence. Crisp editorial layout with restrained object scale and plenty of air. Rich natural materials and subtle grain, no cartoon look.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide editorial illustration for the technical README of DALE, a conversational shopping agent. Landscape 2:1 composition. Matte black background #111111 with a sculptural central arrangement of three softly rounded rectangular panels made of smoky transparent glass and polished charcoal aluminum, slightly offset in three-dimensional space. A delicate silver filament passes from the left panel through the middle to the right panel, like a single thought becoming an action. Very subtle engraved abstract horizontal lines in the panels; no readable text, no fake user interface, no products, no code, no arrows or diagram labels. Reflections of off-white studio softboxes, precise edge light, understated embossed details, no colored light. Editorial product photography meets architectural model. Strong negative space above and below. Refined, quiet, physically plausible, high contrast yet soft. Exclusively off-white, silver, charcoal and black. This represents conversation, grounded context and website action; it must look like premium conceptual artwork, not a screenshot.

exports: 1600px wide progressive JPEG, quality 83; original generated PNGs retained outside the repository.
